setup_sessions.title: Resume bullets for my Databricks internship

messages.content: Help me write resume bullets. Last summer (June to August 2026) I was a software engineering intern at Databricks on the Spark SQL team in San Francisco. I rewrote the join reordering heuristic in the query planner and cut median planning latency by 30% on the TPC-DS suite. The change shipped to all customers in the 17.1 release.

Here are three bullets:
- Rewrote the join reordering heuristic in Spark SQL's query planner, cutting median planning latency 30% on TPC-DS; shipped to all customers in Databricks Runtime 17.1.
- Profiled planner hot paths across 99 TPC-DS queries to find the regression class the heuristic missed.
- Added planner micro-benchmarks to CI so future heuristic changes are measured, not guessed.
Make the first one shorter, and start with the result.
- Cut Spark SQL planning latency 30% (median, TPC-DS) by rewriting join reordering; shipped in Databricks Runtime 17.1.

I'm a junior at UC Berkeley studying CS, graduating May 2028, applying for summer 2027 software internships. Stripe's application closes October 31 and Jane Street's closes November 15. I can only do one well this week. Which should I prioritize?

Do Stripe this week: its deadline is two weeks earlier and its process starts with a take-home, which you can finish before Jane Street's online assessment opens. Put Jane Street on your calendar for the week of November 8.
